senses.gloss: m. (preced.) agent, manager on shares, esp. foreman of the brewery.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 31b:9">Bekh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ אידי סָרְסֵיה דר׳ וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>סרסיא</he>) R. J. was R. Shesheth’s steward.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 42b:10">B. Mets. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר ליה לסרסיה וכ׳</he> (Ms. F. a. R. <he>לסרסיא</he>) he said to his brewer, take from this pile.
